mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.5% signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:FEDFUNDS averaged below 2.5% over prior 6 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4.5% triggers positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days as tight labor markets boost corporate profits and consumer spending.
failure_condition: UNRATE doesn't drop below 4.5% or returns are negative despite the drop.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in GDP demand (GDPC1) above 11,000 for 3 months signals economic expansion, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings rise.
failure_condition: GDPC1 doesn't sustain growth or returns are negative despite the expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO above 112.5 for 3 months indicates supply-side strength, boosting investor confidence and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO doesn't sustain the increase or returns are negative despite the rise.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and fall in UNRATE signals dual expansion pressures, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Proxies move in opposite directions or their combined effect doesn't correlate with returns.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.5% triggers positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate prolonged growth.
failure_condition: Regime isn't late-cycle or FEDFUNDS don't decline sufficiently, or returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in PAYEMS above 140,000 persons triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as strong labor demand boosts corporate profits and consumer spending.
failure_condition: PAYEMS doesn't cross threshold or returns are negative despite the surge.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP demand (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals broad economic expansion, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Proxies move in opposite directions or their combined effect isn't significant.
